artifacts.summary: Re-verifies every declaration behind gates (a1)-(a3) and (b) against the live tree, finds (a1)/(a3)-Stage-1 already C2-pinned, task 706's refutations unlanded, no non-degenerate sliced inhabitant exhibited (probe: Embedded.liveFamily.sliced (-1) decides Certifies, against a stale build), re-derives the Shape-(S) allowlist, and specifies C36 (non-vacuity/coverage-limit) and C37 (shape) with Beer et al. vocabulary.

memory_candidates.content: After a commit landed through a dispatch worktree, the main tree's .lake/build oleans can lag the sources (observed: sources 2026-10-02 01:54 vs oleans 2026-10-01 10:42 for PlusSlicedCertificate/Stable.lean). `lake env lean` probes then silently answer about the OLD definitions - a landed `by decide` theorem was reproduced as false. Before trusting any decide/#eval probe, compare olean vs source mtimes (stat) or rebuild; never report a probe contradiction with a landed theorem without this check.

In scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, C2's AXIOM_BASELINE doubles as an existence check: a renamed or deleted pinned declaration makes `#print axioms` error and the whole-string equality fail. So a new 'declaration must continue to exist and stay axiom-clean' guard should assert membership in AXIOM_BASELINE (C21-style subset) plus a --no-build structural grep, not add a second `#print axioms` pass (which would also force the hard-coded pin-count word in C2's pass message to change).

Mechanical Shape-(S) enumeration (definitions whose body contains a biconditional under a reflexive relational guard): run the awk pass over `def/abbrev/structure/class` blocks and print the first line containing the U+2194 arrow per hit; on this tree the certificate subtrees yield 30 hits, of which only (C1')'s untl/snce conjuncts over `trans` (reflexive via the skeleton field `trans_refl`) are residual collapses. The archived task-699 script `audit/enumerate-shape-s.sh` is the re-runnable source of the three passes.
